hints.title: Check Feasibility
hints.text: At least one job must be done each day. If len(jobDifficulty) < d, return -1.

hints.title: State Representation
hints.text: Let dp[day][i] be the minimum difficulty to schedule the first i jobs in day days.

hints.title: Partition Transition
hints.text: For the current day, try all possible split points j < i. Day difficulty is max(jobDifficulty[j:i]) plus dp[day-1][j].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential partition search without memoization exceeds time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D DP rolling array uses O(N) memory while computing minimum schedule difficulty in polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly formulates the partition recurrence and handles day bounds.
complexity.notes: Can be optimized to O(D * N) using a monotonic stack.
